entities.summary: Khudu Surkhay oglu Mammadov, was a Soviet-Azerbaijani scientist, screenwriter, and nationalist ideologist. Mammadov was a member of the ⁣⁣Azerbaijan Academy of Sciences and a Doctor of Geological and Mineralogical Sciences.
